start.topic: Perimeter of rectangles, squares and polygons
start.opening: Namaste Kabir, main Asha, aapki AI teacher. Aaj perimeter seekhenge. Aapko rectangles, squares ya polygons mein kaunsa shape pasand hai?

turns.reply: Perimeter matlab shape ki poori boundary ki length—fencing jaisi. Sabhi sides ki lengths jodiye. Bittu ko aap ise kaise batayenge?
Kabir, polygon ka perimeter nikalne ke liye uski har side ki length add kijiye. Agar sides 3, 4, 5 m hain, total kitna hoga?
